scope: Reduce Adaptive Contrast backdrop grid sampling to twice per second per window, or four times per second while dragging an About window.

checks.command: Build liquidglass_x11 with KWin 6.6.5, both compositor modules with KWin 6.7.4, and liquidglass with KWin 6.8.2.

Run tests/acrylic_glass_capture.py under isolated KWin 6.7.4 for Wayland (Tahoe material) and X11 (Golden Gate notification islands). Verify plugin identity, rendered pixels and X11 backdrop notification.

Animate the same X11 notification backdrop every 35 ms for five seconds under each build. Observed 25 updates at a median 203 ms on v0.85.35 and 10 at 503 ms on the candidate. Settled RGB frame SHA-256 matched: e6594faa57f90a788d5db2d771b8b280f57f6c5e03f6807d903b9f0ed04913c1.

coverage_limits: Measured X11 notification backdrop updates. Per-glyph sampling has a separate 80 ms timer. End-user desktop FPS was not measured.
